body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #262 head e2d5c9a3 (dotfiles-T90, GitHub identity separation by role; Codex security seat): manifest key worker_gh_config_dir (default ~/.config/gh-worker) rendered as WORKER_GH_CONFIG_DIR into model-profiles.env with shell-safe validation; herdr-agents selects the worker gh config in every worker hand-off (pair pane via `pane run` after the shell prompt, spawn-seated workers through a narrow exported `herdr` adapter that adds --env on tab creation and prefixes the boot command; Codex workers additionally get a worker-only shell_environment_policy.set.GH_CONFIG_DIR override because inherit=core drops the variable; GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN and enterprise variants are cleared so file storage wins); scripts/check-tools.sh doctor check: missing worker dir = optional warning naming the operator step, existing dir = required checks (user-owned 0600 hosts.yml, file-stored active token via `gh auth status --json hosts` (supported by gh 2.101), two different logins, worker dir != default dir); scripts/require-crit-review.py github_identity_errors: active only when the worker hosts.yml exists and effective main rules require >= 1 approval (otherwise a notice and pass), then requires current login != PR author and the latest decisive review by the current login to be APPROVED on the current head, failing closed on malformed GitHub responses; README ruleset payload kept as a draft that the operator must not apply yet (revise round 1 after the task-level audit: required approval alone still lets an approved worker PR be merged by its author and blocks orchestrator-authored boundary PRs; T90b designs the update restriction with the orchestrator as sole pull_request-mode bypass actor), roles section and operator phase (login into the worker dir with --insecure-storage, setup-git, status, make doctor, then stop until T90b); SKILL step 10 approves before the sweep once active; one pr-integration rule bullet. Tests: launcher env propagation, doctor states, gate inactive/active/stale/dismissed; 778 unit tests pass; render-check clean; CI 13/13 green on 507e9c15 after three update-branch merges and a doctor fix for an empty XDG_CONFIG_HOME. One late Codex P2 (retire the sandbox exception once provisioned) is not applicable at this merge and recorded as T83 wording work. Live legs (second account, ruleset PUT, worker restart, scratch-PR 405 check) are operator-side and not performed by this acceptance.
